question: Which of the following organisations has declared October 2 as the International Day of Non-violence to honour Gandhi’s ways?

options.text: International Federation Red Cross and Red Crescent

solution:
The Correct answer is __**United National General Assembly**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **United Nations General Assembly (UNGA)** declared October 2 as the **International Day of Non-Violence**.
 
• This day commemorates the birth anniversary of **Mahatma Gandhi**, a global leader in the non-violence movement.
 
• The day aims to **disseminate the message of non-violence** through education and public awareness.
 
• It was established by the UNGA resolution **A/RES/61/271** on June 15, 2007.
 
• The resolution reaffirms the universal relevance of the principle of **non-violence** and the desire to secure a culture of peace, tolerance, understanding, and non-violence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **International Federation Red Cross and Red Crescent**__

 __
 
• The **International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC)** is the world's largest humanitarian network.
 
• It provides assistance without discrimination as to nationality, race, religious beliefs, class, or political opinions.
 
• Founded in **1919** in Paris in the aftermath of World War I.
 
 
 
• **United Nations Development Fund**__
 __
 
• The **United Nations Development Programme (UNDP)** works in around 170 countries and territories, helping to achieve the eradication of poverty, and the reduction of inequalities and exclusion.
 
• UNDP helps countries to develop policies, leadership skills, partnering abilities, institutional capabilities, and build resilience to sustain development results.
 
 
 
• **Amnesty International**__
 
 
• **Amnesty International** is a global movement of more than 7 million people who take injustice personally.
 
• They are campaigning for a world where human rights are enjoyed by all.
 
• Founded in **1961** by the lawyer **Peter Benenson**.
